business_summary.text: Shanti Gold International Limited is a manufacturer of gold jewellery, focusing on studded jewellery (75% of revenue) and plain gold jewellery (25%). The company operates in the organized jewellery market, supplying to retailers and expanding its manufacturing capacity.

call_points.text: Core PAT margin guided at 3.5-4% for FY27, excluding inventory gains.
Total installed capacity to reach nearly 7,900 kg per annum once Marol and Jaipur additions are operational.
Dubai subsidiary incorporation extended to June 2026 due to geopolitical situation; a couple of licences remain.
Export share targeted to rise from 10% to 20% or more, spanning USA, Singapore, Malaysia, UK and other countries via Dubai.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth of 30-40% and value growth of 60-70%, with revenue of ₹3,000-3,500 Cr and core PAT margin of 3.5-4%

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: Inventory valuation changed from FIFO to weighted average cost with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.
Revenue bifurcation: 70% from existing jewellery line, 30% from new plain gold line.
Top customer contributes 7% of volume/value; company has more than 400 customers.
Export revenue constitutes 4% of total revenue in Q1FY27
Marol facility (4,000 kg capacity) commenced operations in June 2026
Jaipur facility (1,200 kg capacity) expected to be operational by mid-November or December 2026

timeline.summary: Shanti Gold held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, guiding FY27 revenue to ₹3,000-3,500 Cr with 30-40% volume growth and a 4% core PAT margin.
Shanti Gold International Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 20, 2026, reporting a 144.69% YoY revenue growth to ₹716.38 Cr and maintaining FY27 guidance at ₹3,500 Cr.

watchlist.text: Dubai subsidiary: a couple of licences still pending

watchlist.response: Management said core margin of 3.5-4% is sustainable; additional margin only if gold prices rise.
watchlist.text: Whether the 4% PAT margin is sustainable if gold prices remain steady or decline.

watchlist.response: CFO said last year's volume growth was 15%, and FY27 projection of 40%+ shows growth, not a reduction.
watchlist.text: Whether volume growth guidance was reduced from 60-70% to 30-40%.

watchlist.response: Attributed to revenue growth from ₹1,106 Cr to ₹2,018 Cr; expects days to come down as product mix changes.
watchlist.text: Debtor days increased from 42 to 49 in FY26.

watchlist.response: The negative cash flow is due to the business model of keeping stock readily available for customers; it could turn positive if the company shifts to an order-to-order basis.
watchlist.text: Negative cash flow from operations due to high inventory levels
